newsitem.title: USA: Man arrested for murder of U.S. rap singer.
newsitem.headline: Man arrested for murder of U.S. rap singer.

text.p: A New York man wanted in connection with the killing of an aspiring female rap singer and the beating of another singer has been arrested and has confessed to the murder and beatings, police said Wednesday.

Police said Fitzroy Morris, 30, who came from Antigua, gave detectives a written statement implicating himself in the murder of Rushiandra Cooper, 23, and the brutal assault on her friend, Marsha Davis, 21.

Both women were last seen alive at about 4:30 a.m. EST Friday after they left the Q Club in the Jamaica section in the city's borough of Queens. They were reported missing by their families on Saturday.

The victims were discovered inside a nearby convenience store Sunday. Cooper was bludgeoned to death and Davis was half-naked and covered with blood. Davis suffered severe head injuries and was in stable condition at an area hospital, police said.

A tip by an alert hotel clerk who recognised the wanted man from newspaper photographs led detectives to Atlantic City, New Jersey, where Morris was arrested on a fugitive warrant for previously assaulting his ex-wife in Brooklyn, New York, police said.

At the time of his arrest he was in possession of property belonging to both victims. He is being held by New Jersey police pending a hearing on Thursday and will then go to New York to face murder and attempted murder charges.
